Welcome to MCBB
Welcome to the interdepartmental graduate program in Molecular Biology, Cell Biology & Biochemistry (MCBB), which offers both PhD and MS degrees. MCBB students explore the molecular biosciences with an interdisciplinary approach by pursuing coursework, seminars, and world-class research with faculty members in Biology, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Computing and Data Sciences, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Health Sciences, and Physics. The MCBB Program prepares students for research and/or teaching positions in academia, industry, and government. I encourage you to explore the details of our graduate programs, current students, and recent news.
Zeba Wunderlich
Director, Program in MCBB and Associate Professor of Biology
